name: Re;quartz
source:
The main character suffers from narcolepsy, and finds himself stuck in a timeloop where the day of the closing ceremony repeats time and time again.

Each playthrough increases the amount of choices available. However, no matter what, you only have a day, and the future won't come without sacrifices...
